title: trianthella racemosa
intro: Trianthella racemosa, commonly known as Chinese angelica or dong quai, is a plant species in the family Apiaceae. It has been traditionally used in Asian medicine to treat various health issues due to its rich profile of health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and anti-aging properties. The therapeutic actions of trianthella racemosa include its ability to stimulate blood circulation, reduce menstrual cramps, and alleviate symptoms of menopause. The bioactive constituents of this plant include ferulic acid, ligustilide, and butyl phthalide, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
